cast-first.label: Cast first: open OGS, cast, the TV becomes the console home

marks.text: Cast first: open OGS, cast, the TV becomes the console home
Open OGS. Nothing on the TV yet: tap Cast to TV
Pick the living room TV: the TV boots the OGS home
The phone is now a remote. Right on the d-pad: focus moves on the TV
Got it. The iPads already sit on the couch, waiting

launch.label: Pick and start Rocket Crew with the remote (who's playing on the TV)

marks.text: Pick and start Rocket Crew with the remote (who's playing on the TV)
Right: Bake Shop
Left: back to Rocket Crew, paused at mission 6
A: Rocket Crew's page on the TV
A on Continue: who's playing? Last crew is picked; Juneau's iPad lights up
Left to Ava
A: Ava joins as helper; her iPad lights up
Down to Start
Start: Rocket Crew opens in the same stream; phone is Captain, iPads get their pads

swap.label: Swap: Rocket Crew mission 6 → Home → Bake Shop day 4 (4 taps, 0 kid taps, 0 recasts)

marks.text: Swap: Rocket Crew mission 6 → Home → Bake Shop day 4 (4 taps, 0 kid taps, 0 recasts)
Home: the TV returns to the launcher, Rocket Crew suspended at mission 6; iPads pause
Right: Bake Shop, day 4 · 3 of 5 orders
A: Bake Shop's page; tonight's crew is already on it
A on Continue: mission 6 saved, Bake Shop starts in the same stream; iPads follow by name

swap-list.label: The same swap from List mode (3 taps)

marks.text: The same swap from List mode (3 taps)
Home
List: the TV row as tiles on the phone
Tap Bake Shop: its page opens on the TV and the phone
Continue: day 4 in the same stream; iPads follow

word-duel.label: Your turn on the TV → play it on the phone

marks.text: Your turn on the TV → play it on the phone
Down: Your turn has a 2
A: the two turns on the TV (who, last move, score; never your letters)
A on Nana: the board opens on the phone; the TV only says a turn is happening
Play WAVE: sent to Nana; Mom's turn is next on the TV

remote-handover.label: Jonathan's phone sleeps; Mom picks up the remote

marks.text: Jonathan's phone sleeps; Mom picks up the remote
Mom: Take the remote. The TV says it's Mom's now
Her d-pad moves the same focus

recast.label: The cast drops; cast again resumes Rocket Crew at mission 6

marks.text: The cast drops; cast again resumes Rocket Crew at mission 6
Cast again: the TV picks up mission 6, the iPads drop back into their pads
